personas.name: Tree Willard
personas.goal: Tree sets up a codified revenue-share flow agreement with a named founding contributor (2% NAO revenue, founding tier, no expiration, full transparency), watches a simulated 6-month epoch, then inspects the flow ledger to confirm the agreement terms are represented faithfully — not just that value moved.

personas.name: Simon (QB)
personas.goal: Simon configures FlowPolicy for his AWIP core team context (floor=$7K, ceiling=$15K, gradient generous-early, demurrage=simulation-only), runs a 3-month synthetic epoch that dips below floor in month 2, and verifies gradient transitions, demurrage is visible but not live, and the cascade preview reaches the bioregional recipients.

personas.name: Yara Osei
personas.goal: Yara sets up FlowPolicy in felt-threshold mode (no dollar amounts), confirms the system-derived range, enables 5% commons-pool tithe, then opens the velocity view and sees that a synthetic circle member in deficit is already receiving support from Yara's outflow — without Yara taking any manual action.

_sha256_method: Concatenation of persona files in alphabetical filename order (simon-qb.md + tree-willard.md + yara-osei.md), SHA-256 of the raw bytes. Reproduce: python3 -c "import hashlib; files=sorted(['simon-qb.md','tree-willard.md','yara-osei.md']); data=b''.join(open(f,'rb').read() for f in files); print(hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest())" from within the personas/ directory.
